run_kinect2_camera_image: run the kinect2 camera example to capture and display RGB and depth images
create_robot_kinect2: create a Robot instance with kinect2 to access camera functionality
get_rgb_depth: get RGB and depth image arrays from the kinect2 camera using get_rgb_depth

display_camera_images: display color and depth camera images using cv2 imshow windows
